siguiente.descripcion: Duggee helps the Squirrels learn about all the amazing things trees do for the creatures who live among them.

lista.descripcion: Aprende Peque · Series Infantiles
Duggee helps the Squirrels learn about all the amazing things trees do for the creatures who live among them.
Duggee and the Squirrels go on a mission to contain an outbreak when Roly inadvertently goes on the run with the world’s smelliest cheese.
The Squirrels stumble upon Duggee's old radio equipment and discover that Duggee used to have his own radio show. The Squirrels decide to start their own, earning lots of fans.
When Roly does the opposite of what Norrie asks him to do, she struggles to describe what an 'opposite' is. Duggee and some animal friends explain everything.
Tag is feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast.

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Family Photo Badge
lista.descripcion: Duggee is putting up a picture of himself with his old friends. This inspires the Squirrels to take a photo of their own, but Duggee then spends a long time searching for everyone who should be in it.
One Hundred shows us what she's made of in a big song about being big. Learn all about the number 100 with the Numberblocks.
One wonders if anyone could be bigger than One Hundred, and has a big think about some very big numbers indeed. Learn about huge numbers with the Numberblocks.
It's time for the grand finale but the number fun doesn't stop here: there's so much more to explore! Step into the wonderful, wider world of numbers with the Numberblocks.
It's time for some bouncy fun as the Numberblobs take over the show. Learn about number lines, comparing numbers and more with the Numberblobs.
The Numberblocks discover a magic spell that makes them all invisible. Uh-oh! Learn how to write numbers with Numberblocks Zero to Nine.
Ten presents a rundown of the top hit songs in Numberland. Learn number bonds to six, seven, eight, nine and ten with the Numberblocks.
Peg and Cat can dance with their idol Misty Copeland, if Cat can overcome a big obstacle-his tail!

Pato is going to show a movie for his friends, who will be the audience. He shows us the screen, the seats and the projector. Everything is going well until the film gets jammed and the audience laughs. Pato gets angry but his friends manage to get him to sit down and enjoy the show with them.

lista.titulo: Pocoyó - La muñeca nueva de Elly
lista.descripcion: Elly’s new doll has two arms, two legs and one head. Elly has to run an errand, so she leaves her doll with Pocoyo and Pato. When she returns, her doll is not in the same condition as when she left. Will they be able to put things right?

Pocoyo, Pato and Elly are setting up a circus that will have acrobats, jugglers and clowns. The show begins. At first, the performers are not very coordinated, but in the end the performances are very entertaining and the audience has a great time.

Elly’s bedroom has a bed and a closet full of clothes. Pato’s room has a bedside table and a lamp. Pocoyo’s is full of toys. All three think they have the best bedroom, but which of the three is best?
Elly plays a game of school with Baby Bird and Caterpillar, as Pocoyo and Pato refuse to join. After seeing how fun school can be, the boys later change their minds.

Los niños se aburren de los columpios de siempre, así que el padre de Bluey los lleva de paseo hasta el arroyo. Bluey se encuentra fuera de su zona de confort, pero descubre la belleza de la naturaleza.
¡Hay hadas en casa de Bluey! Colas trenzadas, pegatinas por todas partes… ¡Y a mamá le cuelgan pinzas por la cara! La familia debe unirse para dar caza a esas traviesas invisibles.

Juegan a trabajar y papá contrata a Bluey y a Bingo en su fábrica de tuberías. Luego, Bluey toma las riendas, pero su padre considera que la jefa nueva es muy dura; ¡sobre todo porque no les deja bailar!

lista.titulo: Bluey - Bumpy y el sabio sabueso
lista.descripcion: Bingo está enferma en el hospital, así que Bluey y su padre le hacen un vídeo para animarla. Cuenta la historia de Bárnicus y su aventura para curar a su perrito Tornado.
¡El padre de Bluey y Bingo tiene que dejar de jugar e irse a trabajar, pero las niñas lo lían para que siga jugando con ellas en la cama elástica todo lo posible!
De camino al punto limpio, el padre de Bluey les cuenta que es el mejor en todo, pero ella descubre que va a tirar sus dibujos viejos y empieza a dudar de si de verdad es el mejor padre del mundo.
Oona and Baba help the seagulls defeat the Great Gull.

lista.titulo: Pregunte a los StoryBots - ¿Cómo crecen las flores?
lista.descripcion: Los StoryBots obtienen una vista panorámica del viaje de una flor, desde la semilla hasta la floración. David Cross actúa como estrella invitada como el amigo de espíritu libre de Bang.

lista.titulo: Los Octonautas en tierra firme - Lonely Frog
lista.descripcion: Paani and the team help a water frog search for more of his species.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Good as New
lista.descripcion: While out on a delivery to Whiff's Recycling Plant with his beloved buddy Boxy in tow, Thomas realises that his pal is on his last crooked axle.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - More Than a Pretty Engine
lista.descripcion: After a storm causes a rockslide in Crumble Canyon, Ashima is eager to clean and clear the chaos with her new friends. However, Thomas and the others are concerned if Ashima were to help them, the mucky mess could ruin her beautiful paint.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Snowplow Struttin'
lista.descripcion: When Thomas is assigned to guide Diesel and Percy on their deliveries in case of snow, he must learn that he needs to use his plow responsibly for his friends and their tasks!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Thomas in Charge
lista.descripcion: When Gordon leaves Thomas in charge for the day, Thomas sees it as his chance to prove what a good leader he is.
An overwhelmed Simon tries to keep secrets for both Gaspard and his mom.
Simon accidentally draws all over the walls.
Gaspard gets on Simon's nerves while at the beach.

lista.titulo: Robocar Poli - A Spring Cleaning Disaster
lista.descripcion: While working to clean up Brooms Town, Posty accidentally tosses his beloved stamp collection. Now, he must find it before it's lost forever.
Bruner asks Max to look after Bruny. But when Max gets distracted, Bruny disappears. The Rescue Team must do what it takes to find their missing pal.
A message inside a fortune cookie inspires Spooky and Lifty to travel westward. Little do the friends know they're heading straight for danger.
El mundo de Luna · Series Infantiles
El mundo de Luna · Series Infantiles

lista.titulo: Jorge El curioso - George and the Jug Owl
lista.descripcion: It's New Year's Eve, and George is excited to stay up for the party. He tries to nap but can't fall asleep. / When George accidently gets gum on his fur, he tries all sorts of ways to get rid of it only to make things worse!

After Tom Thomas' friend, Katya, leaves her cell phone at his apartment he wants to read her text messages. Simka and Nolik know it's wrong and try to stop him from reading letters that aren't his to read.
Tom Tomas played with the ball at home, and the last hit completed the game: the ball hit the chandelier.
Tom Tomas got hungry and decided to cook his own food. Fixies will then realize that he is not a "wimp."

Playing a mad scientist, Tom Thomas stirs up his soapy magic potion with his father's electric toothbrush and it breaks. Now Simka and Nolik must help him fix the toothbrush before his dad comes in the bathroom to brush his teeth.
Aunque Hank y sus amigos no logran silbar, la señorita Mona les enseña otras maneras de hacer música. Pronto, deciden hacer uso de su talento y formar una banda.

lista.titulo: Dr. Seuss: Pez rojo, pez azul - Awake/Asleep + Hot/Cold + Clumsy/Graceful
lista.descripcion: On a snowy Christmas Eve, the friends try to stay up and see Santa Fish. Later on, they hit the pool to stay cool, then bundle up to go ice skating.

lista.titulo: Dora, la exploradora - Feliz Dia de los Padres (Father's Day)
lista.descripcion: Dora makes a kite for her Papi on Father's Day, and must retrieve it when it gets blown away.

lista.titulo: Paw Patrol: Patrulla de Cachorros - Los cachorros salvan a Walinda / Los cachorros salvan el gran hueso
lista.descripcion: El equipo rescata a la amiga de Wally, Walinda, quien va a tener un bebé. El capitán Turbot y su primo Francois quedan atrapados mientras buscan restos de dinosaurios.
Leo, Tig and their friends established some kind of a “ship" on a tree and play sea travelers. Jealous of them, Martens plan to take hold of the ship. But how to do that? Spike has a plan.
Bo explores why the moon seems to change shape to help Ms. Astronaut Lady safely land her spaceship. Scarlett Johansson guest-stars.

El zoo del jardín de Bluey alberga animales maravillosos, como el gran gorila azul que es su padre. Sin embargo, cuando atrapa a Bingo y escapa, Bluey, como cuidadora, debe capturar al animal salvaje.

¡Mamá y papá van a vivir una aventura y llevan a las traviesas niñas como mochilas! Disfrutar de las vistas y de la comida de los puestos… ¡Qué divertido es ser mochilero! Hasta que pierden el pasaporte.
Princesas, caballos y varitas mágicas. Bluey y Chloe pueden jugar en el papel que quieran en esta aventura en la que salvan el reino del patio de la Reina Codiciosa.
Bluey se está divirtiendo imitando todo lo que hace y dice su padre, pero el juego se interrumpe por algo serio. Encuentra a un periquito herido y tienen que irse urgentemente al veterinario.
Sigue las aventuras de un cachorro de Blue Heeler que vive con su papá, su madre y su hermanita.

El grupo de juego de Bluey está en peligro, porque el hospital de bebés de Indy es incompatible con los caballeros y dragones de Rusty. Sin embargo, al explicar sus razones, descubren que ambos juegos tienen mucho en común.
Doodle asks Odo to teach her how to be funny.
Sheriff Labrador · Series Infantiles
Lucas the Spider finds a place to cool off during summertime.

lista.titulo: Baby Einstein Ocean Explorers - Let's Explore: Counting Starfish Arms!
lista.descripcion: Go ashore to learn about tidepools and the kinds of animals within them, like starfish and sea anemone!

El lobo engaña a Pinocho y Crong para dejar el pueblo, pero Gepetto les sigue el rastro de cerca. ¡El lobo intenta escapar con los dos amigos!

lista.titulo: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood - Daniel se va de picnic
lista.descripcion: Daniel Tiger and his friends Prince Wednesday and Miss Elaina are having a picnic at the park near the clock factory. When it starts to rain, their picnic is ruined, leaving them very disappointed. Dad Tiger helps them turn their disappointment around with an inside picnic instead - inside the clock factory where the friends find something else good when they get to hear “chime time” together.

lista.titulo: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood - Daniel va a la escuela
lista.descripcion: Daniel is visiting school for the first time and is a little nervous because he doesn’t know what it will be like there. He packs his backpack with his favorite playthings from home - a lot of things! Teacher Harriet shows him around his classroom, and Daniel is surprised to find so many familiar things there. He learns that asking questions is one way to learn about something that’s new - and to feel more comfortable there.

lista.titulo: Las aventuras de Los Elegidos - No seas borrego (parte 2)
lista.descripcion: Oveja se hace amigo de una ingeniosa paloma que le cuenta todo sobre su vida en Cafarnaúm. Juntos viajan a la gran ciudad, donde un encuentro inesperado con una niña de nueve años lo conduce hasta el Pastor que siempre soñó seguir.

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - Escuela de monstruos
lista.descripcion: En Halloween, Cleo, Cuquín y Maripí quieren ver pelis de miedo, pero eligen una tan mala que da risa. Ahora deben enseñarle a los monstruos cómo asustar. ¿Qué pasará?

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - Un mundo gigante
lista.descripcion: A Cuquín se le escapa un balón que destroza el nuevo invento “agrandacosas” de Tete... ¡que de pronto encoge a Cleo, a Tete y a Cuquín! ¿Podrán reparar la máquina?

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - Una nueva amiga
lista.descripcion: Jugando con Cleo, Cuquín saca del agua a Nita, una sirena. La pobre no sabe volver a casa, pero Cleo cree que pueden ayudarla. Eso sí, ¡no será tan fácil como imaginan!

lista.titulo: Cleo y Cuquín - Tesoros bajo la arena
lista.descripcion: Buscando tesoros en la playa, Cleo, Cuquín y Pelusín encuentran una vieja casa rodante oxidada y deciden restaurarla. ¿Lograrán transformarla en un tesoro?

It’s Caillou’s first day at day care and he really doesn’t want to go. But once he gets there he meets his teacher, Miss Martin and makes two new friends, Leo and Clementine. Day care is a fun place, after all and when his Mommy comes to pick him up, Caillou doesn’t want to go home!

lista.titulo: Caillou - Caillou tiene miedo de la oscuridad
lista.descripcion: Caillou can’t get to sleep because he’s sure there’s a monster in his bedroom. Mom and Dad try to reassure him, but things go from bad to worse when he thinks his toy snake is real. Dad shows him that the scary noises he hears are being made by a tree branch brushing against the window and in the end, the only ‘monster’ in Caillou’s room is Gilbert the cat.

lista.titulo: Blippi: Las aventuras educativas de Blippi para niños - Canción Del Barco
lista.descripcion: Boat Song de Blippi Boats para niños. ¡The Boat Song de Blippi es un gran video de barco para los niños! Visto por millones, a su hijo le encantará cantar y bailar las canciones infantiles de Blippi. Blippi hace videos educativos para niños en edad preescolar.

lista.titulo: Blippi: Las aventuras educativas de Blippi para niños - Canción Del Coche De Policía
lista.descripcion: Canción del coche de policía de Blippi Coches de policía para niños. ¡The Police Car Song de Blippi es un excelente video de autos de policía para niños! Visto por millones, a su hijo le encantará cantar y bailar las canciones infantiles de Blippi. Blippi hace videos educativos para niños en edad preescolar.

lista.titulo: Blippi: Las aventuras educativas de Blippi para niños - Canción De Formas
lista.descripcion: Canción Shapes de Blippi Learn Shapes for Toddlers. ¡The Song Song de Blippi es una excelente manera de aprender formas para niños en edad preescolar! Visto por millones, a su hijo le encantará cantar y bailar las canciones infantiles de Blippi. Blippi hace videos educativos para niños en edad preescolar.

lista.titulo: Little Baby Bum: ¡Hora de cantar! - Old MacDonald / The Clean Up Song / The Hello Song
lista.descripcion: Timberly dresses like a farmer to teach the class about barnyard animals. Later, the kids tidy up the classroom and learn greetings in other languages.

lista.titulo: Little Baby Bum: ¡Hora de cantar! - Row, Row, Row Your Boat / Oh Dear! What Can the Matter Be? / Ants Go Marching
lista.descripcion: The kids learn the magic of singing songs in a round, then solve a silly mystery: Where's Tootson? Max leads a march in star-shaped sunglasses.

lista.titulo: Little Baby Bum: ¡Hora de cantar! - Peek-A-Boo / Hopping Song / Down by the Bay
lista.descripcion: On Halloween, the kids wear their costumes to school. Pop, pop... hop! Ahan brings bubbles to class! Timberly helps her students write a song.

lista.descripcion: Ahan's pet fish inspires a lesson about singing and breathing. Timberly teaches the class about the piano, then the kids make music with everyday items.

lista.descripcion: The kids celebrate Valentine's Day, then learn that tap shoes make really fun sounds. Timberly and her cousin Kimberly teach the class about harmony.

Abby's wand amazes Cookie, who ponders all the cookies he could make if he had it. Meanwhile, Ice Cube teaches Elmo the meaning of the word "astounding"; and Furry Potter and Professor Crumblemore teach children how to follow directions.

lista.titulo: Pistas de Blue y tu - Uno, dos y tres con Blue
lista.descripcion: Cuenta con Josh y Blue en este juego de Las pistas de Blue para averiguar qué quiere comprar Blue en la tienda. Ayudamos a Shovel & Pail a saber quién tiene más galletas graham y luego ayudamos a Josh a descubrir qué puede comprar con sus dólares Blue.
